summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for Pulse Player error handling and feature enhancements:
- Unified error dispatch and global Snackbar system in AppShell
- Playback resilience with automatic fallback and missing track skip
- Safe AudioFx initialization and status diagnostics
- Library scanner error recovery and scan summary dialog
- Storage and SAF backup validation with user-friendly error dialogs
- In-app Diagnostics & Error Log screen/dialog in Settings
- Missing track badges and auto-cleanup for unreachable audio files
